macos_release.detail: 172 CLI checks, 34 failure checks, SHA vectors, transforms, saved golden archives

linux_release.detail: Pi Zero 2 W, aarch64, GCC 12; full suite; final FIFO/open-race regression included (172 CLI checks, 34 failure checks)

linux_lsan.detail: Dedicated persistent suite: 532 valid/malformed parser cycles and transform tests, plus final seven-path CLI leak recheck including FIFO rejection; no leaks reported. Full per-process LSan suite was superseded because of Pi scan startup cost.

linux_asan_ubsan.detail: Full suite; detect_leaks=0 because dedicated LSan validation is separate; final FIFO/open-race regression included (172 CLI checks, 34 failure checks)

linux_tsan.detail: Full separate suite; serial host; final FIFO/open-race regression included (172 CLI checks, 34 failure checks)

cross_platform_exchange.detail: Both plain and gzip; exact file bytes, modes and SHA-256; raw archive byte-identical across platforms

streaming.detail: Mac 24 MiB plain/gzip and Pi 18 MiB plain/gzip round trips; cmp and SHA-256 match. About 9 MiB encode RSS on Mac; about 15 MiB reported RSS on Pi. Pi encoding roughly 6 minutes; throughput remains a practical limitation.

failure_injection.detail: Disk-full, sync/permission failures, source mutation, cancellation before/after commit, no-overwrite, scratch budgets and cleanup

archive_fuzz.detail: 134994 cases over 121 seconds, ASan/UBSan, outer checksum repaired

packaging.detail: Deterministic source bundle, per-file SHA-256, native binary manifest, standalone extracted source build; isolated installation checked

licensing.detail: Owner confirmed CAT/XF/LambdaScript first-party ownership and MIT licensing; third-party terms retained

ci.detail: Workflow prepared and YAML syntax checked; user requested local-only; GitHub Actions not executed

release_state: development candidate validated locally and on Pi; no public release/tag/upload performed; CI execution intentionally deferred
known_limits: 4096 entries, depth 64, 2 MiB manifest; configured byte/disk budgets
Regular files/directories and 0777 modes; no timestamps/ownership/ACL/xattr/link preservation
SIGKILL/power loss/unsupported directory fsync cannot guarantee crash-durable publication
TSan coverage is serial; workers remain deferred
Apple Clang 21 lacks LSan/libFuzzer runtimes on this target; Homebrew LLVM 23 used for fuzzing; Pi Clang14 crashed compiling XF, GCC12 passed
Pi encode throughput on the 18 MiB synthetic incompressible input is about 50 KiB/s; large/interactive workloads need performance work.
build_config_note: Final native regression uses the same runtime sources and Makefile as the local candidate, with explicit CC=cc. Dedicated LSan persistent coverage predates only the archive file-type/open-race fix; final CLI leak paths were rerun after that fix.
